rules.name: Business Logic — Price Manipulation
rules.description: Detects price manipulation attempts via negative quantities, zero-price items, or modified totals in checkout
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent, AzureDiagnostics | where Message contains "wstg" or Message contains "business-logic" | summarize count(), make_set(SourceIP) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), ActivityDisplayName | where count_ > 3

rules.name: Business Logic — Rate Limit Bypass
